description: Synthetic producers for the #7 generator: scripted scenario producers, the #34 scope-test pair, and contrast pairs that share a challenge tag but differ in crop, region or entity type. Projects use English text written for this file, without names. Survey answers use the sample's wording and only #14 allowlisted columns.

producers.note: S1: Colombian coffee smallholder in Cauca facing drought. Contrast C1 with SYN-005 and C4 with SYN-008.

projects.title: Drip irrigation for dry-season coffee plots
projects.sub_category: Climate Change Mitigation/Adaptation (Clean Energy, Agroforestry etc.)
projects.description: Installed drip lines and a 5,000-litre storage tank so young coffee plants survive the longer dry spells of the last three seasons.

projects.title: Shade trees over the coffee plot
projects.sub_category: Climate Change Mitigation/Adaptation (Clean Energy, Agroforestry etc.)
projects.description: Planted guamo and plantain between coffee rows to cool the plot and hold moisture in the soil during hot, dry months.

producers.note: S2: Mexican coffee cooperative facing a price drop. Contrast C2 with SYN-007.

projects.title: Price stabilization fund for members
projects.description: Set aside part of the Premium as a fund that tops up the price paid to members when the export price falls below the cost of production.

projects.title: Dry mill to sell green coffee directly
projects.description: Built a small dry mill so the cooperative can sell green coffee to buyers directly instead of selling parchment to intermediaries.

projects.title: Shared picker crews at harvest
projects.description: Organized crews of pickers shared between member farms, with transport and meals, because young people leaving for cities left farms short of hands.

producers.note: S5 and S7: Côte d'Ivoire cocoa cooperative facing drought. Contrast C1 with SYN-001.

projects.title: Cocoa agroforestry against drought
projects.sub_category: Climate Change Mitigation/Adaptation (Clean Energy, Agroforestry etc.)
projects.description: Gave members fruit and timber seedlings to plant among cocoa trees, to shade the trees through longer and hotter dry seasons.

projects.title: Nursery for drought-tolerant cocoa seedlings
projects.sub_category: Climate Change Mitigation/Adaptation (Clean Energy, Agroforestry etc.)
projects.description: Set up a cooperative nursery that raises drought-tolerant cocoa seedlings to replace trees lost in the last dry season.

projects.title: Transport for harvest workers
projects.description: Rented trucks to bring harvest workers from neighbouring villages during the main crop, when farms could not find enough labor.

projects.description: Equipped a health post on the farm with a part-time nurse, so workers no longer lose a day travelling to the town clinic.
